descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员在对[From.GetName]进行了一番详细调查后确认该星球在几十亿年前曾被海洋覆盖，但是星球的玄武岩化学构成十分特殊，令其具备很强的吸水性，最终[From.GetName]的岩石将地表所有的水都给吸干了。昔日覆盖地表的海水如今只剩下一条条的盐卤点缀着[From.GetName]为数众多的峡谷。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]说现在[From.GetName]地表的众多富含矿物质的水合物可以成为重要的工业资源。
descriptions.en:
Following a thorough investigation of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] crew has confirmed that the planet used to be covered in flowing water, several billion years ago. However, the geochemical composition of the planet's basalt crust proved highly hydrophilic - so much so, that [From.GetName]'s thirsty rocks eventually absorbed and bound all of the water on its surface. Now all that remains of these vast oceans are salty brine streaks lining [From.GetName]'s numerous canyons.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] adds that the mineral hydrates now dominating [From.GetName]'s landscape could have many valuable industrial applications.

descriptions.zh:
关于[From.GetName]，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]有一些令人不安的发现。星球表面的植物数量异常庞大，而且这些植物专门狩猎动物。各种各样的食肉植物散发着香气作为诱饵，吸引猎物上钩。植物的触须可以敏感的发觉动物的接近，等猎物进入捕食范围后就迅速罩住猎物阻止其逃脱，然后用消化液将猎物缓慢的腐蚀掉。

[Root.GetLeaderName]警告说如果要在这颗星球上殖民，必须远离这些食肉的植物，因为这些植物完全有能力困住一个落单的成年人[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]。
descriptions.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has made some troubling finds on [From.GetName]. The planet's megaflora is not only widespread and gargantuan in proportion, but also predatory. Various species of carnivorous plants rest patiently on its surface, releasing aromatic lures into the air and waiting for prey to come near. Sensitive tendrils on the terminus of the plant's leaves register the approach of animals, resulting in the plants snapping shut around their hapless prey, which are left to be slowly corroded by digestive acids.

[Root.GetLeaderName] warns that any future colonists will have to steer clear of these predatory plants, as they appear more than capable of trapping a lone adult [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName].

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员完成了研究任务，并战战兢兢地回来了。至于在[From.GetName]上到底看到了什么，每个人的汇报都含糊不清，矛盾之处颇多，但有一点大家的回复是完全一致的：覆盖整个星球表面的流动的海洋具有生命。

尽管星球上的海洋没有任何器官组织和肉体，但却可以通过能影响接收者脑波的频率来进行交流。它可以让接收者感受到思想、画面、情感……除此之外，它对不同个体的影响也不同。现在还不清楚如果长期接收这个海洋的频率会对接收者有什么样的影响，也不知道这种接收频率行为是否安全。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]请求在下达一个行星§Y特殊项目§!以进一步研究[From.GetName]上这片奇异的海洋。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew has returned from their research mission visibly shaken. They provide vague, often conflicting reports of what they encountered on [From.GetName] - though in one matter they are all united: the still-flowing sea that wraps pole to pole around the planet is somehow alive.

Though it bears no organs or corporeality we can identify, the planetary ocean seems to communicate with frequencies that affect the brain activity of the recipient. It is able to induce thoughts, images, emotions... and what is more, affects each individual differently. It is entirely unknown what effects prolonged contact with this sea might have, or how safe such an endeavor would be.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] requests that a §YSpecial Project§! to study this strange sea be enacted on [From.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]单位从研究任务中返回，但并没有得到确定性的数据。虽然这片覆盖整个星球的流动的海洋没有器官组织、也没有身体，但却拥有神经交互功能，这个有意识的海洋很可能是被热力学平衡的某个随机的波动创建出来的，但详情我们就不清楚了。

还有，星球上的海洋似乎能使用某种频率来进行交流，该频率能影响有机生命体的认知系统，现在还不清楚长期接收这片海洋的频率会对有机生命体物种产生何种影响，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]没有受到这个分散的神经网络的影响。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] units have returned from their research mission with inconclusive data. Though it bears no organs or corporeality we can identify, the still-flowing sea that wraps pole to pole around the planet appears to be a neural entity unto itself. It is possible this conscious entity was created by the random fluctuations of thermodynamic equilibrium, though the details escape us.

Furthermore, the planetary ocean seems to communicate with frequencies that may affect the cognitive wetware of organic beings. Though it remains unknown what effects prolonged contact with this sea might have on organic species, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are unaffected by the output of this dispersed neural network.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]的[controller.GetResearcherPlural]已经完成任务带着原始数据返回。虽然这片覆盖整个星球的流动的海洋没有器官组织、也没有身体，但在行星表面的这个翻腾不息的海洋似乎是某种活生生的实体。

行星上的海洋似乎在使用一种能激起接受者体内神经活动的频率进行交流。我们的每个[controller.GetIndividualNamePlural]都感受到了一些外部思想、图像、杂讯的投影……不过这并无效果，这个实体的感应很快就被我们弹回了。

它似乎还无法构成一个像我们一样的意识。在长期的暴露下，该交流频率能影响其他有机生命体的认知系统，但这种脉冲对我们来说没有影响。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] [controller.GetResearcherPlural] have returned from their mission with inconclusive data. Although it bears no organs or corporeality we can identify, the still-flowing sea that wraps pole to pole around the planet appears to be some form of living entity.

The planetary ocean seems to communicate using frequencies that attempt to induce neural activity within the recipient. Each of our [controller.GetIndividualNamePlural] was met with a projection of foreign thoughts, images, glandular impulses... But the effort was in vain, and the entity soon recoiled from us.

It seems this being cannot comprehend a consciousness like ours. It is possible that other organic forms may be affected by long-term exposure to this attempt at communication, but we are immune to its impulses.

label.en: We don't have time for this.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]上实施殖民地决议之后，一支研究团队将部署在轨道上，从安全的距离研究奇特的海洋。

由于无法进一步研究[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]协助发现的神秘物体，科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]表示十分失望。但本着任务比个人兴趣更重要的原则，[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]愿意接受[living_planet_scientist.GetHisHer]目前的任务。
descriptions.en:
With the enactment of the Colony Decision on [From.GetName], a research team will be placed in orbit to study the strange sea presence at a safe distance.

Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName] has expressed some regret at being unable to further study the mysterious entity [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] helped discover, but [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] [living_planet_scientist.GetIsAre] willing to accept [living_planet_scientist.GetHisHer] current assignment as taking precedence over personal interests.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]上实施殖民地决议之后，一支研究团队将部署在轨道上，从安全的距离研究奇特的海洋。

轨道上的研究团队想马上开始进行研究，如果有任何突破进展，他们会告知我们。
descriptions.en:
With the enactment of the Colony Decision on [From.GetName], a research team will be placed in orbit to study the strange sea presence at a safe distance.

The orbital team is eager to begin their study, and will be sure to keep us apprised of any breakthroughs.

label.zh: 有什么消息及时通知我们。

descriptions.zh:
我们从科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]那里收到了异常的通讯联络。[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]要求立即将自己调往[living_planet_tar.GetName]轨道上的研究站。[living_planet_scientist.GetName]声称[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]日夜不停地思考着星球上的神秘海洋存在，并且[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]承认这些思绪并非都属于[living_planet_scientist.GetHisHer]自己。

这一请求可谓是学术与疯癫各参半，一边说明这海中生物有能力在神经上影响与其接触的有机生物，一边却宣称这正是它用逝去的爱人的声音与[living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer]沟通的原因。

我们无法确定[living_planet_scientist.GetName]能否继续履行职责。但另一方面，如果允许[living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer]与轨道科研团队共事，或许可以为我们提供深入了解[living_planet_tar.GetName]星球上的神秘存在的机会。
descriptions.en:
We are receiving an unusual communique from Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName]. Apparently, [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] [living_planet_scientist.GetIsAre] requesting immediate transfer to the orbital research team on [living_planet_tar.GetName]. [living_planet_scientist.GetName] claims [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] [living_planet_scientist.GetHasHave] been hounded night and day by thoughts of the mysterious sea presence on the planet - thoughts, [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] attest[living_planet_scientist.GetSXX], that are only partly [living_planet_scientist.GetHisHer] own.

The request wavers on the precipice between academic and rambling, suggesting the sea presence possesses the ability to imprint neurologically on those it comes into contact with - only to allege that this is why it speaks to [living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer] in the voice of lost loved ones.

It is unclear if [living_planet_scientist.GetName] is unfit for further duty. On the other hand, allowing [living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer] to cohabitate with the research team may give them the opportunity for deeper insights into the entity on [living_planet_tar.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了来自科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]的一份不同寻常的公报，似乎想要立即被调往位于[living_planet_tar.GetName]轨道上的科研空间站。[living_planet_scientist.GetName]宣称其整日整夜都在想着那颗星球上的神秘海中生物，不过承认这些思绪并非都属于自己。

这一请求可谓是学术与疯癫各参半，一边说明这海中生物有能力在神经上影响与其接触的有机生物，一边却宣称这正是它用逝去的爱人的声音与其沟通的原因。

我们无法确定[living_planet_scientist.GetName]能否继续履行职责。但另一方面，允许其与轨道科研队伍共事，或许可以为我们提供深入了解[living_planet_tar.GetName]星球上的神秘存在的机会。
descriptions.en:
We are receiving an unusual communique from Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName]. Apparently, they are requesting immediate transfer to the orbital research team on [living_planet_tar.GetName]. [living_planet_scientist.GetName] claims they have been hounded night and day by thoughts of the mysterious sea presence on the planet - thoughts, they attest, are only partly their own.

The request wavers on the precipice between academic and rambling, suggesting the sea presence possesses the ability to imprint neurologically on organic beings it comes into contact with - only to allege that this is why it speaks to them in the voice of lost loved ones.

It is unclear if [living_planet_scientist.GetName] is unfit for further duty. On the other hand, allowing them to cohabitate with the research team may create the opportunity for deeper insights into the entity on [living_planet_tar.GetName].

tooltips.zh: 允许§Y科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]§!离开当前岗位并加入[living_planet_tar.GetName]科研团队。
tooltips.en: Allow §YScience Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName]§! to leave our service and join the [living_planet_tar.GetName] research team.

label.zh: 绝对不行，让科学专员立刻回到岗位上去。
label.en: Out of the question. Return the officer to duty at once.

tooltips.zh: 命令§Y科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]§!继续留在当前岗位上。
tooltips.en: Command §YScience Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName]§! to remain at their current post.

label.zh: 解职[living_planet_scientist.GetName]：这名研究员的思想显然已被控制。
label.en: Dismiss [living_planet_scientist.GetName]: the officer is clearly compromised.

tooltips.zh: §Y科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]§!将被解职且无法再被使用。
tooltips.en: §YScience Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName]§! will be decommissioned and no longer available.

descriptions.zh:
在[living_planet_tar.GetName]轨道上的研究团队对星球上神秘海洋的研究已经取得重大进展，研究人员认为星球上的海洋是某种灵能体：虽然此海洋没有身体，但却有复杂的相干量子波结构，从而构成了一个前所未见的巨型神经网络。

团队的研究让我们发现了一个惊人的灵能理论，并加深了我们对量子态与意识之间交互的理解。这个研究所深入的科研领域远远超出了[Root.GetName]上的水平。
descriptions.en:
Our research crew in orbit of [living_planet_tar.GetName] has made a series of fascinating breakthroughs regarding the planet's strange sea of consciousness. The crew has described the planetary sea as a psionic entity: its seemingly incorporeal state in fact belies a complex and coherent quantum wave structure, approximating a massive neural network unlike any other on record.

The crew's research has led to astounding insights into psionic theory, and deepened our understanding of the interaction of quantum states and consciousness. We now have access to a field of scientific discovery hitherto unimagined in the [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
位于[living_planet_tar.GetName]轨道研究站的研究团队最近在星球神秘海洋的研究上取得重大突破。研究专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]对团队的贡献尤其突出。研究人员认为星球上的海洋是某种灵能体：虽然此海洋没有身体，但却有复杂的相干量子波结构，从而构成了一个前所未见的巨型神经网络。

[living_planet_scientist.GetName]的研究让我们发现了一个惊人的灵能理论，并加深了我们对量子态与意识之间交互的理解。至于[living_planet_scientist.GetName][living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer]本人嘛：我们的这位前科学专员会继续留在轨道研究站上观测星球上的神秘海洋。
descriptions.en:
Our research crew in orbit of [living_planet_tar.GetName] has made a series of fascinating breakthroughs regarding the planet's strange sea of consciousness. With Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName] acting as an invaluable asset to the team, the crew has described the planetary sea as a psionic entity. Its seemingly incorporeal state in fact belies a complex and coherent quantum wave structure, approximating a massive neural network unlike any other on record.

[living_planet_scientist.GetName]'s research has led to incredible insights into psionic theory, and deepened our understanding of the interaction of quantum states and consciousness. As for [living_planet_scientist.GetName] [living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer]self: our former Science Officer will remain on the orbital facility for as long as we maintain it, observing the entity from afar.

descriptions.zh:
我是科研专——不，是前科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]。我无法理解上面的人做出的让我深陷如此窘境的愚蠢决定，既然我的要求被你们无视，那么我只有一个选择了。

[living_planet_tar.GetName]上面有个智能意识体，不对，准确的说是，[living_planet_tar.GetName]§E本身就是§!那个智能意识体。你们不会明白的，因为你们没有切身体会过，不过你们很快就会体会到了。
descriptions.en:
This is Science Offi - former Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName]. I cannot pretend to understand the narrow-minded decision making that has led me here, but as my requests have fallen upon deaf ears, there is only one course of action left to me.

There is a consciousness on [living_planet_tar.GetName]. No, not on it. [living_planet_tar.GetName] §Eis§! the consciousness. You won't understand. How could you? You haven't felt it. Not yet.

label.en: What is the meaning of this?

descriptions.zh: 探测器发现科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]驾着个人着陆舱从[living_planet_tar.GetName]的轨道上脱离并以最快速度坠入了海洋，我们认为[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]没可能幸存，同时也没有发现着陆舱的残骸。
descriptions.en: Sensors report that Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName] was registered dropping from orbit around [living_planet_tar.GetName] in a personal landing pod. Crashing into the ocean at maximum velocity, we cannot imagine [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] survived. There are no traces of the pod remaining.

descriptions.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]进行环境改造，试图将其转化为没有海洋的星球，此行为产生的结果在我们预料之中。星球上具有意识的奇特海洋被我们的环境改造工程所彻底扰乱，并失去了之前与我们进行频率交流的能力以及生物体的一切特性。

由于失去了这个珍贵的研究对象，[Root.GetAdj]科学家们都感到十分惋惜，毕竟这个神秘海洋在整个星系都是独一无二的。
descriptions.en:
The terraforming of [From.GetName] into a sealess landscape has had a predictable, but unavoidable outcome. The strange sea of consciousness on the planet's surface has been completely disrupted by our terraforming process, and has lost the unique properties that qualified it as a living being to our survey team.

[Root.GetAdj] scientists lament the missed research opportunities that the loss of such a unique galactic entity will entail.

descriptions.zh:
一个传奇的生物游动于[Root.GetStarName]星系的气态巨行星之间，它比已知的任何缇扬奇都要大，简直就是一头无比巨大的太空巨鲸。这个族母的触须比[Root.Owner.GetAdj]的战列舰还要长，其皮肤闪着亮光，在黑暗的太空中异常的耀眼。她的历史十分悠久，身上的伤疤说明她已历经无数次战斗。

族母的背上有个巨大的未爆炸的鱼雷。星系中的破碎舰船残骸提醒着我们不要轻易靠近她，否则必会被这巨物毁灭。
descriptions.en:
A creature of legend swims languorously between the gas giants in the [Root.GetStarName] system. Larger than any Tiyanki on record - indeed, larger than any of our projections could have allowed for, a space whale of impossible proportions seems to have made her nest here. With tentacles longer than a [Root.Owner.GetAdj] battleship, this magnificent Matriarch's glowing hide stands out startlingly against the void of space. She is old, remarkably so, a veritable ancient covered end to end in battle scars and strange growths.

A gigantic, unexploded proton torpedo is lodged in the venerable creature's back, and the fractured remains of ships in the system speak of what manner of fate befell any vessels that strayed too close.

descriptions.zh:
一个传奇的生物游动于[Root.GetStarName]星系的气态巨行星之间，她的触须比[Root.Owner.GetAdj]的战列舰还要长，其巨大的身体颠覆了我们对有机生命体的认知，该生物的皮肤闪着亮光，在黑暗的太空中异常的耀眼。她的历史十分悠久，身上的伤疤说明她已历经无数次战斗。

族母的背后有个巨大的未爆炸的鱼雷。星系中的破碎舰船残骸提醒着我们不要轻易靠近她，否则必会被这巨物毁灭。
descriptions.en:
A creature of legend swims languorously between the gas giants dotting the [Root.GetStarName] system. With tentacles longer than a [Root.Owner.GetAdj] battleship, her gargantuan proportions defy all of our previous encounters with organic life. The creature's magnificent glowing hide stands out startlingly against the void of space. She appears to be quite old, remarkably so -- a veritable ancient covered end to end in battle scars and strange growths.

A gigantic, unexploded proton torpedo is lodged in the venerable Matriarch's back, and the fractured remains of ships in the system speak of what manner of fate befell any vessels that strayed too close.

descriptions.zh:
我们大获全胜的舰队在濒死的缇扬奇族母身旁游弋，她那闪闪发亮的肉身上布满了弹孔和伤痕。她那巨大的触须虽然仍试图捕捉附近的舰船，但动作逐渐放缓，最终停了下来。

就这样，古老的族母被终结了，就像那些在我们之前企图围捕她的舰队一样。
descriptions.en:
Our victorious fleet circles the dying Tiyanki Matriarch, her glowing flesh scored by countless blast-marks. The violent thrashing of her tentacles, still trying to grasp at nearby ships, first slows, then draws abruptly to an end.

At last she expires: the ancient Matriarch laid to an end, like her would-be hunters before us.

label.zh: 从这头巨兽身上收集基因物质。
label.en: Harvest genetic material from the beast.

tooltips.zh: 解锁用于§Y星神兽转基因§!的§Y多肢化§!特质。
tooltips.en: Unlocks the §YPolymelic§! trait for §YLeviathan Transgenesis§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们还是把事情想的太简单了，上将报告说怪物的肚腹中有奇怪的东西在动。

有什么东西要从怪物肚腹中钻出来了！
descriptions.en:
...Or so it had seemed. Our fleet captains are reporting strange movement coming from the belly of the beast.

Something is about to emerge!

titles.en: From the Belly of the Beast

descriptions.zh:
一艘沾满了黏液、腐蚀严重的神秘舰船冲出了缇扬奇族母的肚腹，我们舰队做好交战准备，但那艘船突然关闭了武器系统和引擎系统。

他们向我们发来联络！
descriptions.en:
A mysterious vessel, covered in viscous fluids and damaged by digestive juices blasts its way out of the corpse of the fallen Tiyanki Matriarch. Our fleet stands at the ready, but the ship immediately powers down its weapons and engines after emerging.

They are hailing us!

descriptions.zh:
我是亚哈船长号的舰长瑞斯·昂多，我们被困在这怪物肚中已经很久了，几十年前我为了复仇而准备消灭这只怪物。

结果报仇不成，我们的舰船反倒被这怪物给吞下去了，我还以为这辈子再也没机会看到宇宙群星了，多亏了你们帮忙。

为了感谢你们拯救我们脱险，我们的舰船从现在开始向[Root.GetName]效忠。
descriptions.en:
This is Captain Reth Unddol of the AH4B. Long have I suffered in the caustic bowels of that fell beast. Decades ago I came to hunt it, to repay a debt long overdue.

Alas, I could not lay this baleful Matriarch to an end, and when she swallowed the AH4B whole, I was certain I would never again see the light of the stars. I am glad to see I was mistaken.

For putting my nightmare to rest, I would pledge my life and loyalty, and my ship, to the [Root.GetName].

tooltips.zh: 我们只要你们的船就够了。
tooltips.en: Just your ship will do.

tooltips.zh: 你们是有机生物，因此必须被消灭掉。但你们的船我们可以留下。
tooltips.en: You are organic. You will be exterminated. Your ship, however...

tooltips.zh: 猎物。我们会实现缇扬奇未竟的遗志。
tooltips.en: Prey. We will succeed where the Tiyanki failed.

tooltips.zh: 此人不过是把燃料。处理掉他。
tooltips.en: He is but fuel for the flames. Get rid of him.

tooltips.zh: [Root.GetName]绝不允许异星生物服侍自己，也不允许任何异星生物活着。
tooltips.en: The [Root.GetName] will suffer no xenos to serve. Or live.

titles.en: From the Belly of the Beast

descriptions.zh:
等等！不！你不能——不要碰我！

啊啊啊啊！
descriptions.en:
Wait! No! You cannot -- get away from me!

HRGAAAAHHH!!

titles.en: From the Belly of the Beast

descriptions.zh:
绝对不行。这艘船就是我的命根子……你们在干什么？你们不能把我塞进逃生舱！

住手！我的话还没说完……！
descriptions.en:
Out of the question. This ship has been my only lifeline for... what are you doing? You cannot just stuff me in an escape pod!

Stop! You haven't heard the last of me...!

descriptions.zh: 经过一段漫长的仪式，§Y缇扬奇族母§!从彼岸归来，并为我们的事业而效力。
descriptions.en: After a lengthy ritual, the §YTiyanki Matriarch§! has returned from beyond and now serves our cause.

descriptions.zh:
复活§Y缇扬奇族母§!格外困难。即便我们已经有控制她小型子嗣的丰富经验，但族母的再生能力反复地吞噬掉我们的虫草[root.GetNecromancersLower]。但最后，我们更胜一筹；死掉的组织永远也不可能比我们更具适应力。

现在，我们控制了族母，她的巨型鞭毛已经为我们所用了。
descriptions.en:
Reanimating the §YTiyanki Matriarch§! was especially difficult. While we have gained plenty of experience seizing control of its smaller offspring, the Matriarch's regenerative capabilities proved to be a significant drain on our cordyceptic [root.GetNecromancersLower]. But in the end, we triumphed; no dead tissue could ever adapt faster than us.

Now, having taken control of the Matriarch, we twitch the titanic flagella.

descriptions.zh: §Y缇扬奇族母§!已重新启动并重目的化。该巨型生物将作为一个有机单元服务于我们。将其原生的族母协议停用后吧，该星神兽现在将为我们所控制。
descriptions.en: The §YTiyanki Matriarch§! has been rebooted, and repurposed. This titanic creature will now serve us as an organic unit. With matriarchal protocols disengaged, this leviathan will now operate under our control.

descriptions.zh:
根据初步调查结果显示，科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]确认从轨道上观察到的孤立遗迹确实是[From.GetName]曾有人居住的唯一证据。不幸的是，[Root.GetName]的船员们进行直接调查这一举动并不明智。

[From.GetName]上有一片被称为“区域A”的地方存在着建筑物的遗迹，其范围大约十三公里见方，除此之外别无任何智慧生命的痕迹。区域内散布着性质奇特的人造物，从微型力场发生器到可溶穿钢铁并长时间扩散的险恶液体都有。更奇怪的是，整个区域都弥漫着使访问者感到心满意足的气息，尽管周围的许多物体都可能有害。

[Root.GetLeaderName]提出的假设是，一个有遨游太空能力的有机文明曾访问过[From.GetName]，留下了这些东西——尽管它们是谁，为何来此，以及为何离开仍是个谜。
descriptions.en:
As per initial findings, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] confirms that the isolated ruin seen from orbit is indeed the only evidence of settlement on [From.GetName]. Unfortunately, the [Root.GetName] crew is little the wiser for having investigated the structures firsthand.

Devoid of any other traces of sapient lifeforms, [From.GetName] possesses a zone of roughly thirteen by thirteen kilometers, dubbed Zone A, in which the remains of buildings can be found. Artifacts possessing bizarre properties litter this zone, from minute forcefield generators to viscous fluids that melt through steel and expand over time. Even more peculiar: the entire zone permeates its visitors with a deep-rooted sense of contentment, despite the often-dangerous mysteries of the objects found therein.

[Root.GetLeaderName] posits the working theory that a space-faring civilization visited [From.GetName] sometime in the past, leaving behind these objects - though who they were, why they landed, and why they left remain unknown.

[From.GetName]上有一片被称为“区域A”的地方存在着建筑物的遗迹，其范围大约十三公里见方，除此之外别无任何智慧生命的痕迹。区域内散布着性质奇特的人造物，从微型力场发生器到可溶穿钢铁并长时间扩散的险恶液体都有。更出人意料的是，整个区域内遍布着使人心满意足的情绪模拟器，尽管周围的许多物体都可能有害。

[Root.GetLeaderName]提出的假设是，一个有遨游太空能力的有机文明曾访问过[From.GetName]，留下了这些东西——尽管它们是谁，为何来此，以及为何离开仍是个谜。
descriptions.en:
As per initial findings, Science Unit [Root.GetLeaderName] confirms that the isolated ruin seen from orbit is indeed the only evidence of settlement on [From.GetName].

Devoid of any other traces of sapient lifeforms, [From.GetName] possesses a zone of approximately thirteen by thirteen kilometers, designation 'Zone A,' in which the remains of buildings can be found. Artifacts possessing unusual properties litter this zone, from miniaturized forcefield generators to viscous fluids that melt through steel and expand over time. Even more unexpectedly: the entire zone permeates emotional-emulators with high levels of contentment, despite the many potentially harmful properties of the objects found therein.

[Root.GetLeaderName] posits the working theory that a space-faring organic civilization visited [From.GetName] sometime in the past, leaving behind these objects - though who they were, why they landed, and why they left remain unknown factors.

tooltips.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!上发现了§Y区域A§!。
tooltips.en: §YZone A§! has been discovered on §Y[From.GetName].§!

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员报告称，有个一开始被探测器判为小行星的物体其实是一颗巨大的漂浮垃圾球。它由各种载具，火箭，以及有害物质（其中许多具有放射性）的破损残骸组成，似乎是某个处于早期太空时代的未知外星帝国的废弃物。

这个帝国似乎习惯于向太空抛弃垃圾，将危险的工业废弃物抛向轨道而不是在星球上丢弃。辐射测量显示这些废弃物已有数百万年历史，并且自离开其未知来源起几乎一直都在虚空中漂流。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]注意到这块漂浮垃圾中的某些材料非常稀有，并且可以精炼成有用的资源。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew report that what first appeared to our scanners as an asteroid is in fact a gigantic, floating ball of junk. Comprised of the broken remains of various vehicles, rockets and hazardous materials (many of them radioactive), the junk ball seems to be the detritus of an unknown alien nation in the early space age.

It would appear this nation was an interstellar litterer, ejecting dangerous industrial waste into orbit rather than disposing of it planetside. Radiometric dating suggests these remains are millions of years old, and have been floating through space from an unknown point of origin for most of that time.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] notes that some of the materials found on this floating junk heap are quite rare, and could be refined into useful resources.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员报告称，在[From.GetName]星系附近发现了腐朽的轨道空间站与多个死寂星球。某个曾殖民于[From.GetName]星系的星际文明似乎很久以前就毁灭了。[ratling_planet_tar.GetName]星球简直就像个垃圾场，上面满是辐射弥漫且锈迹斑斑的建筑废墟，基础设施与载具。未侦测到高等生命的存在。

我们或许可以勘察该星系与邻近星系中的类似星球，来获知更多关于这一失落文明的情报。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew have reported the presence of decaying orbital stations and multiple tomb worlds near the [From.GetName] system. Whatever interstellar nation once inhabited the [From.GetName] system appears to have collapsed into ruin long ago. [ratling_planet_tar.GetName] is a junkyard of a planet, covered in the irradiated, rusting remnants of demolished buildings, infrastructure and vehicles. No higher forms of life are recognizable.

We might gain more insight into this lost civilization by surveying any similar planets in this and neighboring systems.

label.en: If any remain, they will be exterminated.

descriptions.zh:
正如[Root.GetName]船员的初步猜想，[From.GetName]似乎是那个有遨游太空能力的帝国的首都，其前殖民地现在已是死寂星球上的充满辐射的废墟。

从团队收集的数据看来，几乎可以确定是一场对未知外部威胁发动的星际战争，导致了这个失落文明的陨落。我们仍不确定星球的主人是击退了攻击者但毁于战后的辐射尘，还是攻击者消灭了这些殖民地及其居民并扬长而去。

因废墟的极端环境使我们无法从残留的电子器件中提取数据，而其首都和其它殖民地中也没有任何生还者，这似乎将成为不解之谜。
descriptions.en:
As per the [Root.GetName] crew's initial suspicions, [From.GetName] appears to be the fallen capital of the space-faring society whose former colonies are now but irradiated scrap heaps on inhospitable tomb worlds.

From the data the team has gathered, the downfall of this lost civilization was almost certainly the result of interstellar warfare waged against some unknown, external threat. It remains unclear whether the planet's owners repelled the invasion but succumbed to the post-war fallout of a pyrrhic victory, or if the invaders crushed these colonies and their inhabitants before moving on.

As the extreme state of ruin on the planet precludes the extraction of data from any remaining electronics, and neither the capital nor its colonies possess any survivors, it seems we may never know for certain.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]收到了关于[notif_planet.GetStarName]星系中的[notif_planet.GetName]曾被以为是不毛之地的情报。我们的勘探者曾以为是无法居住的废墟星球，事实上住着一群像老鼠一般的智慧生物！

它们被命名为“鼠人”，这些生物一直隐居在巨大废墟中的隧道里，使我们无法察觉。一定是这些巨大垃圾堆的复杂结构与惊人密度，阻挡了我们的扫描仪深入其中。

是什么使得鼠人来到地面仍不得而知，不过我们现在既然观察它们，我们注意到它们的科技几乎完全基于行星废墟中的破旧垃圾。

难道鼠人是创造了这些废墟的失落星际文明的最后幸存者吗？深入研究或许可以一探究竟。
descriptions.en:
Intelligence reports are coming in to [Root.Capital.GetName] regarding the hitherto lifeless surface of [notif_planet.GetName] in the [notif_planet.GetStarName] system. What our surveyors initially considered an uninhabited junk pile of a planet is, in fact, home to a species of rat-like sapients!

Dubbed "Ketlings," these creatures had been living hidden from our view in tunnels in the planet's enormous scrap piles. The complex composition and incredible density of these massive junkheaps must have hindered earlier penetration by our scanners.

Whatever may have brought the Ketlings to the surface is thus far unknown, though now that we can observe them, we have noted their technology is almost entirely based on repurposed junk from the planetary ruins they inhabit.

Could the Ketlings be the last survivors of the lost interstellar civilization who made these ruins? Closer study may yield more information.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetLeaderName]对[From.From.GetName]上的鼠形智慧生物的调查产生了惊人的结论。这些鼠人是灵能体，可以通过横跨数百万小型个体的巨大心灵感应网络来共享思维。尽管它们似乎避免与我们接触，而我们也没有发现它们拥有先进太空科技的证据，但将鼠人归类为原始生物却非常不妥。事实上，它们的某些改造机械的技术复杂程度甚至逼近我们的水平。

此外，鼠人既不是这些城市的建造者的后代，也不是将其摧毁的征服者。鼠人的祖先，其实是被当初定居此地的星际文明当作宠物的动物！在其主人陨落后，原始鼠人是在这些废墟星球上持续数个世纪的辐射尘中存活下来的少数生物之一。

长期暴露在辐射中加速了鼠人的基因突变，而其灵活的肢体，相对较高的初始智力，并且更接近废弃工具，这些因素导致了一个高科技帝国的迅速发展。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetLeaderName]'s investigation into the rat-like sapients on [From.From.GetName] has produced some surprising results. The Ketlings are psions, capable of sharing their thoughts via a telepathic network spanning millions of small minds. Though they avoid interacting with us, and we lack evidence to suggest they are capable of advanced spaceflight, it would be remiss to classify the Ketlings as mere primitives. In fact, some of their repurposed machinery possesses a technical sophistication approaching even our own.

Moreover, the Ketlings are neither the descendants of the civilization that constructed these cities, nor the conquerors that destroyed them. Rather, the Ketlings were once the pets of the spacefarers who first colonized these systems! After their masters' downfall, the proto-Ketlings were one of the few species to survive centuries of nuclear fallout on these ruined planets.

Constant exposure to radioactive elements led to faster mutations in the Ketlings' genetic code, and their nimble appendages, relative starting intelligence, and close proximity to a variety of decrepit tools all culminated in the rapid emergence of a technologically advanced culture.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经成功的从奇怪的垃圾堆住民鼠人手中占领了[From.From.GetName]。我们将根据物种政策来处理行星上剩余的鼠人。

我们不确定我们的入侵会让它们其他星球上的同伴做出什么样的反应……但是能有多糟？
descriptions.en:
We have successfully conquered [From.From.GetName] from the curious junk-dwelling Ketlings. The Ketlings remaining planetside will be dealt with according to the species policies we have outlined for them.

We are uncertain what kind of reaction our intrusion might prompt from their comrades on other planets... but how bad could it be?

残存的鼠人将被发射至太空中。
descriptions.en:
We have successfully conquered [From.From.GetName] from the last of the junk-dwelling Ketlings. The Ketlings remaining planetside will be dealt with according to the species policies we have outlined for them.

The final remnants of Ketlings autonomy will be dispersed into the void.

我们成功地从奇特的垃圾居民鼠人手中征服了[From.From.GetName]。

这些奇特的垃圾居民鼠人将被吸收进[Root.GetName]。
descriptions.en:

descriptions.zh:
传感器在[sensor_ratling_system.GetName]星系中突然发现了大量活动迹象。先前遭遇的鼠人发射了一队可超光速旅行的战舰，而地面侦查表明其居住的巨大垃圾堆其实隐藏了广阔的复合矿场，发电厂，菌类农场，以及地下科研设施。

尽管十分惊人，它们的船到目前为止尚未表露出敌意，并且鼠人很可能只是在其边境设防而已。无论如何，现在明显该将这些外星人视为一个真正的帝国了。
descriptions.en:
Sensors report a sudden burst of activity in the [sensor_ratling_system.GetName] System. The previously encountered Ketlings have launched a fleet of FTL-capable warships, and planetside reconnaissance indicates the enormous junkheaps that made up their homes in fact concealed extensive mining networks, power plants, fungus-farms, and subterranean research facilities.

While alarming, their ships have thus far made no display of hostile intent, and it is quite possible the Ketlings are merely establishing defenses along their borders. Nevertheless, it is clearly time to recognize these aliens as an empire in their own right.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]星系中发送着一道微弱但反复持续的信号。[Root.GetName]追踪其来源至星系边缘的一个不稳定亚空间裂隙。

另一边究竟有什么呢？
descriptions.en:
A weak, but insistent signal transmits on repeat in the [From.GetName] system. The [Root.GetName] has pinpointed its source to emanating from within the mouth of a destabilized subspace rift at the system's edge.

What could be on the other side?

options.script: name = "distar.240.a"

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]星系内遭遇了一个由纯能源构成的巨大实体！这是个真正的灵能漩涡，必须小心翼翼地靠近。

令人困惑的是，[From.GetName]星系本身似乎与超空间网络完全隔开了。不知道究竟是这个实体的存在切断了超空间网络，还是意料之外的子空间波动将它困在了这里。

不过有一件事是可以确定的：我们当初在[sealed_entry_system.GetName]星系内侦测到的重复信号似乎来自[tanker_planet.GetName]。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has encountered a massive being of pure energy in the [From.GetName] System! A veritable vortex of psionic forces, this entity should only be approached with the utmost caution.

Bafflingly, the [From.GetName] system itself seems to be entirely devoid of any connection to the subspace hyperlane network. Whether this entity's presence has severed the system's hyperlane connections, or if unexpected subspace fluctuations trapped it here is unknown.

One matter is known, however: the repeating signal we first registered in the [sealed_entry_system.GetName] system appears to originate from [tanker_planet.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]星系内遭遇了一个由纯能源构成的巨大实体！我们的船员感受到这个灵能漩涡正在散发强烈的恶意。

令人困惑的是，[From.GetName]星系本身似乎与超空间网络完全隔开了。不知道究竟是这个实体的存在切断了超空间网络，还是意料之外的子空间波动将它困在了这里。

不过有一件事是可以确定的：我们当初在[sealed_entry_system.GetName]星系内侦测到的重复信号似乎来自[tanker_planet.GetName]。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has encountered a massive being of pure energy in the [From.GetName] System! A veritable vortex of psionic forces, our crew senses intense malevolence emanating from the entity.

Bafflingly, the [From.GetName] system itself seems to be entirely devoid of any connection to the subspace hyperlane network. Whether this entity's presence has severed the system's hyperlane connections, or if unexpected subspace fluctuations trapped it here is unknown.

One matter is known, however: the repeating signal we first registered in the [sealed_entry_system.GetName] system appears to originate from [tanker_planet.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]星系首次接触到一个非实体的能量生命体。我方[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]已确认该实体是一个具有潜在敌意的、具有一定智慧的灵能漩涡。

[From.GetName]星系完全脱离超空间航道网络。目前尚不清楚这种脱离是人为设计还是外力所致。但可以确定的是，我们最初在[sealed_entry_system.GetName]星系观测到的重复信号很可能源自[tanker_planet.GetName]。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made first contact with a non-corporeal energy-being in the [From.GetName] system. Our [Owner.GetTelepathPlural] have identified the entity as a potentially hostile, sentient vortex of psionic force.

The [From.GetName] system is completely disconnected from the hyperlane network. It is unclear if the disconnect is by design, or due to an external force. We can however confirm that the repeating signal we first observed in the [sealed_entry_system.GetName] system likely originates from [tanker_planet.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]星系中遇到了某种拥有纯洁能源的巨大物体！这个物体是某种灵能体力量的漩涡，要靠近它的话，必须非常谨慎。

奇怪的是，[From.GetName]星系与亚空间的超空间网络之间的所有连接都断掉了。到底是这个物体切断了此星系的所有超空间连接还是亚空间的某种意外波动将此物体困在了这个星系，无从得知。

有一件事可以确定：我们在这个星系中收到了一个重复发送的信号，该信号来自[tanker_planet.GetName]——但如果我们想要抵达那里的话，首先必须处理掉那个拥有纯洁能源的巨大物体。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has encountered a massive being of pure energy in the [From.GetName] System! A veritable vortex of psionic forces, this entity should only be approached with the utmost caution.

Bafflingly, the [From.GetName] system itself seems to be entirely devoid of any connection to the subspace hyperlane network. Whether this entity's presence has severed the system's hyperlane connections, or if unexpected subspace fluctuations trapped it here is unknown.

One matter is known, however: we are picking up a repeating signal in this system, originating from [tanker_planet.GetName] - though we may need to deal with the entity before we can reach it.

options.script: name = BATTLESTATIONS

descriptions.zh: 被困于[sealed_system.GetName]星系内的那个邪恶的灵能实体终于被消灭，现在我们的科研船应该可以安全地探索这一没有超空间网络的独特宇域。
descriptions.en: With the destruction of the malevolent psionic entity that had been sealed in the [sealed_system.GetName] System, our science vessels should be able to safely explore this unique section of space devoid of hyperlanes.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]已将漂浮在[From.GetName]轨道上的油轮判明为一艘先进的医疗研究船。其建造工艺表明它与[sealed_entry_system.GetName]星系的虫洞分解炮出自同一外星物种之手，而且和那空间站一样，它已被荒废许久。

尽管油轮的数据系统已经无可挽回地劣化了，[Root.GetLeaderName]仍从船上回收了一种非凡的神经再生剂的分子结构。这种药剂似乎用于输液，并且应该可以大幅增强接受者的神经元，神经轴突，以及神经突触的生成。

如果根据[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]神经学进行改造，这一药剂应该可以显著改善任何[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的学习能力。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew have identified the derelict tanker in orbit of [From.GetName] as an advanced medical research vessel. Its construction suggests it was created by the same aliens who built the wormhole destabilizer in the [sealed_entry_system.GetName] system, and like the station, it has been abandoned for quite some time.

While most of the tanker's data systems have suffered irrevocable degradation, [Root.GetLeaderName] has recovered the molecular structure for a remarkable neuroregenerative agent from onboard. The agent appears to work via transfusion, and should serve to significantly increase the generation of neurons, axons, and synapses in its recipient.

If modified to suit [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] neurology, this agent should notably improve the learning capacity of any [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] exposed to it.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]已将漂浮在[From.GetName]轨道上的油轮判明为一艘先进的医疗研究船。其建造工艺表明它与[sealed_entry_system.GetName]星系的虫洞分解炮出自同一外星物种之手，而且和那空间站一样，它已被荒废许久。

尽管油轮的数据系统已经无可挽回地劣化了，[Root.GetLeaderName]仍从船上回收了数个富有社会学价值的数据库。目前正在将其上传至我们的主机以供彻底分析。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew have identified the derelict tanker in orbit of [From.GetName] as an advanced medical research vessel. Its construction suggests it was created by the same organics who built the wormhole destabilizer in the [sealed_entry_system.GetName] system, and like the station, it has been abandoned for quite some time.

While most of the ship's data systems have suffered irrevocable degradation, [Root.GetLeaderName] has recovered a number of databases containing information of significant sociological value. They are now being uploaded to our mainframe for complete analysis.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]附近的空投舱已经在断电状态下漂浮了好一阵子。[Root.GetName]报告称，无论这些外星舱里原本装了什么，都在几百年前就消逝了，只剩下了干瘪的空壳。

不过有一个舱显示内部有活动迹象。尽管其引擎已瘫痪，扫描表明其通讯天线仍旧完好。

我们可以与其通话。
descriptions.en:
The drop pods surrounding [From.GetName] have been drifting powerless for quite some time. The [Root.GetName] reports that whatever aliens these pods were transporting are now but withered husks onboard, having evidently perished hundreds of years ago.

One sole pod, however, has shown signs of onboard activity. While its engines are disabled, scans suggest its communications array is undamaged.

We can hail them.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员为其初次报告被打断而道歉。在通讯中，[phaseshift_planet.GetName]经历了一次彻底的维度转移，它的粒子场旋转进了另一个维度！灵能云团已经消散，显露了一颗宝贵的§Y盖亚星球§!。

迷人的是，随着星球的转移，其量子叠加态似乎已被重置，并且正在以星球仍被§Y虚境星球§!时同等的速度增长。

[Root.GetLeaderName]用量子叠加态的增长速度，以及转移时的量子叠加态总量，推测出星球的转移周期为三个月。或许我们可以设法阻止星球的转移……但首先我们得拥有星系的控制权。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew apologizes for the abrupt termination of their initial report. During transmission, [phaseshift_planet.GetName] experienced a complete dimensional phase shift, its particle fields rotating out of one dimension and into another! The cloud of psionic energy has been lifted, revealing a glittering jewel of a §YGaia World§!.

Fascinatingly, the number of superimposed quantum states appears to have been reset as the planet shifted, and is now increasing at the same rate as when the planet was a §YShrouded World§!.

[Root.GetLeaderName] has used the rate of increase of particle superimposition, and the total number of quantum states at the time of transition to extrapolate a three-month cycle for the planet's dimensional shifts. Perhaps we might develop a method to prevent the planet from shifting... but we should secure the system first.

[From.GetName]周围的残余能源读数表明，不久之前这颗星球上每单位空间内的量子叠加态数量，超出了至今为止被认为是可能数量的上限。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提议称[From.GetName]，这颗被[Root.Leader.GetSheHe]命名为面纱的星球，同时存在于两个维度：我们的维度，以及另一个未知维度。

该星球已经被锁定在当前的相位维度，应该可以安全地进行殖民。
descriptions.en:
Residual energy readings surrounding [From.GetName] indicate the planet not too long ago possessed a hitherto thought impossible number of superimposed quantum states per unit of space. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests [From.GetName], which [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] codenamed The Veil, existed simultaneously in two dimensions in the not-too-distant past: our own, and an unknown other.

The planet has since been locked into its current dimensional phase, and should be considered safe for colonization.

descriptions.zh:
在六个月的繁杂计算，理论推敲，以及激烈争论之后，[Root.GetName]船员设计了一个方案，可将星球的粒子场锁定在一个正常状态，阻止其在两个维度之间旋转。

一道足够调谐的能源应该可以将[phaseshift_planet.GetName]固定为一个状态，将其锁定为一颗稳定的§Y盖亚星球§!。
descriptions.en:
Following six months of number-crunching, theory-busting, and heated debate, the [Root.GetName] crew has devised a method by which the planet's particle fields can be locked into a nominal state, preventing their rotation between dimensions.

A sufficiently tuned pulse of energy should freeze [phaseshift_planet.GetName] in one state, locking it into a stable form as a §YGaia World§!.

tooltips.zh: [phaseshift_planet.GetName]将永久变为一颗§Y盖亚星球§!。
tooltips.en: [phaseshift_planet.GetName] will be permanently transformed into a §YGaia World§!.

descriptions.zh: 既然[phaseshift_planet.GetName]已经在我们的领地之内，我们应该调查稳定该星球维度波动的可能性。如果我们希望在那颗宝贵的§Y盖亚星球§!上殖民，我们必须设法阻止[phaseshift_planet.GetName]每隔三个月就变为§Y虚境星球§!。
descriptions.en: Now that [phaseshift_planet.GetName] is within our borders, we should investigate the possibility of stabilizing the planet's state of dimensional flux. If we wish to inhabit the glittering §YGaia World§!, we will have to devise a method of preventing [phaseshift_planet.GetName] from phase-shifting back into §YShrouded World§! every three months.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[phaseshift_planet.GetStarName]星系内新获得的星球§Y[phaseshift_planet.GetName]§!展现出了一些非同寻常的特性。它被一种只能称之为灵能的能源所包围，[phaseshift_planet.GetName]每单位空间内的量子叠加态数量，超出了至今为止被认为是可能数量的上限。

每隔三个月，叠加态数量就会达到临界值，使[phaseshift_planet.GetName]经历一次彻底的维度相位转移，它的粒子场将会旋转进另一个维度。该旋转会将一个§Y虚境星球§!从另一维度转移至我们的维度，然后在下一个周期结束时再次将一个§Y盖亚星球§!转移回来。

如果我们希望在那颗宝贵的§Y盖亚星球§!上殖民，我们必须设法阻止[phaseshift_planet.GetName]每隔三个月就变为§Y虚境星球§!。
descriptions.en:
Our newly acquired planet §Y[phaseshift_planet.GetName]§! in the [phaseshift_planet.GetStarName] system exhibits some incredible properties. Occluded by a strange envelope of what can only be described as psionic energy, [phaseshift_planet.GetName] possesses a hitherto thought impossible number of superimposed quantum states per unit of space.

Every three months, the number of states reaches a critical level, and [phaseshift_planet.GetName] experiences a complete dimensional phase shift, its particle fields rotating out of one dimension and into another. This rotation phases a §YShrouded World§! from another dimension into ours, only to phase back a §YGaia World§! at the end of the next period.

If we wish to inhabit the glittering §YGaia World§!, we will have to devise a method of preventing [phaseshift_planet.GetName] from shifting back into §YShrouded World§! every three months.

label.zh: 那就想办法来相位锁定那颗星球吧。
label.en: Then let us find a way to phase-lock the planet.

label.zh: 我们还有更重要的事要处理。
label.en: We have more important matters to focus on.

或许我们可以设法阻止星球的转移……但首先我们得确保该星系的安全。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] reports that the planet [phaseshift_planet.GetName] exhibits some incredible properties. Occluded by a strange envelope of what can only be described as psionic energy, [phaseshift_planet.GetName] possesses a hitherto thought impossible number of superimposed quantum states per unit of space.

Every three months, the number of states reaches a critical level, and [phaseshift_planet.GetName] experiences a complete dimensional phase shift, its particle fields rotating out of one dimension and into another. This rotation phases a §YShrouded World§! from another dimension into ours, only to phase back into a §YGaia World§! at the end of the next period.

Perhaps we might develop a method to prevent the planet from shifting... but we should secure the system first.

descriptions.zh:
在对[From.GetName]上覆满植被的建筑进行调查之后，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了它们与栖息在地表上的大量未开化真菌生物之间的可怕关联。

这些建筑似乎是由某种比我们更加先进的文明建造的，用来当作这些真菌生物的有机培养室。此外，这些真菌生物似乎被基因改造成一个用途：作为家畜来填饱其造物主的肚子。

这些生物被[Root.GetLeaderName]命名为[livestock_species.GetName]，是一种思考能力贫乏的温顺生物，这很可能也是其造物主的设计。只需要土壤养分与热量即可存活并繁殖，未来的殖民者们或许可以将它们派上一些用场。
descriptions.en:
Following investigation of the grown-over structures on [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has uncovered a grisly connection between them and the vast population of pre-sapient fungoids living on its surface.

It would appear a civilization more technologically advanced than even our own constructed these structures as organic growing chambers for the fungoids. What is more, the fungoids seem to have been genetically tailored and defined to serve one purpose: filling the stomachs of their creator species, as livestock.

The creatures, termed [livestock_species.GetName] by [Root.GetLeaderName], are a docile species largely incapable of complex problem-solving, likely by their creator's design. Requiring only soil nutrition and warmth to survive and procreate, they could potentially be of some use to any future colonists.

label.zh: 珍贵的有机生物。它们应该得到细心的照顾。
label.en: Precious organics. They deserve the best pampering.

label.zh: 同化价值：低于最佳标准。
它们必须被消灭。迟早有一天。
label.en: They shall be exterminated. All in good time.

label.zh: 如果不采点儿样品不就太不礼貌了吗。
label.en: It would be rude not to have a sample.

descriptions.zh:
既然我们已经在[From.GetName]上殖民，我们得决定该如何处置那些栖息在地表上的未开化真菌生物。

通常情况下，我们关于未开化生物的政策足以在新的殖民地上应对它们。不过，[livestock_species.GetName]看起来确实非常美味。因其非常温顺的天性，将[livestock_species.GetName]们聚集起来赶进处理中心应该不是难事……
descriptions.en:
Now that we have colonized [From.GetName], we should decide what is to be done with the pre-sapient fungoids living on its surface.

In normal circumstances, our policies regarding pre-sapients would be sufficient in dealing with their presence on our new colony. However, the [livestock_species.GetName]s do look particularly delicious. Due to their incredibly docile nature, it should be relatively easy to round the [livestock_species.GetName]s up into a processing center...

label.zh: 确实诱人。但我们将遵守我们的规定。
label.en: Tempting. But we will adhere to our policies.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]船成功地从[From.GetStarName]星系里的奇特干扰中分离出了一个信号。信号的内容是一首歌。确切来说，是一首由复杂数学方程式构成的歌，而且[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]似乎无法不去想它。

是谁或者是什么东西写了这首歌仍不得而知，不过其复杂程度暗示着对子空间和声学的高度精通。信号的测地线表明其来源位于我们的星系之外。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has succeeded in isolating a signal embedded within the unusual pattern of interference in the [From.GetStarName] system. The signal is a song. A complex sonification of an advanced mathematical equation to be precise, and one that [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] cannot seem to get out of their mind.

Who or what may have composed this song remains unknown, though its complexity infers an incredible level of technological sophistication regarding subspace harmonics. The signal's geodesics suggest a point of origin from outside of our galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员回收了[From.GetName]附近的反射性多面体，并将其带回船上仔细研究。该物体的最有趣的特性就是可以反射大多数向其发射的低频能源波束。高频能源波束则不受影响，使该物体的特性无法用于舰队防御。

尽管对其进行了详尽的调查，[Root.GetName]科研团队仍旧无法判明这个奇特多面体的功能，或是来源。它似乎是空心的，但其类金属表面雕刻着某种科学符号。尽管无法获知该编码数据的完整意义，令人困惑的是，[Root.GetLeaderName]相信它与虫洞度量学有关。

通过研究这些科学符号，我们的科研团队在虫洞理论方面取得了令人兴奋的进展。但这个物体的确切用途仍是个谜。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew has recovered the reflective polygonal object near [From.GetName], bringing it onboard for detailed study. The object's most intriguing quality is its ability to reflect most types of low-frequency energy beams directed toward it. High-frequency energy beams, however, remain unaffected, making the object's properties useless with regards to any potential fleet defense applications.

Despite extensive examination, the [Root.GetName] research team has been unable to determine the function, or origin, of this peculiar polygon. It appears to be hollow, but its metalloid surface is engraved with some kind of scientific notation. Though the full meaning of this codified data eludes us, [Root.GetLeaderName] believes it relates to wormhole metrics.

Our research team was able to glean some fascinating insights into wormhole theory by studying these notations. Whatever purpose this object was created for, however, is still a mystery.

descriptions.zh:
对笼罩[From.GetName]地表的巨大金属晶体的研究结果让所有人大吃一惊，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]十分兴奋的告诉我们说这些巨大的晶体其实是数万亿个已经失去行动机能的纳米机器人！

这些纳米机器人的分子结构不属于任何已知帝国的纳米科技，因此无法确定这些纳米机器人的起源。可能是某种未知舰船出于不明原因而将这些纳米机器人散布于这个行星之上的。

[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些纳米机器人将自身改造为完美的晶体格子形状并进行自我复制，直到最后失去机能为止。虽然它们创造的晶体类似于建筑，但其在构成上却是完全一样的，因此无法作为建筑使用。
descriptions.en:
Detailed analysis of the enormous metallic crystals dominating [From.GetName]'s landscape have defied all expectations. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is excited to reveal that these oversized crystals are in fact composed of trillions upon trillions of deactivated nanites!

Their molecular structure matches no known empire's nanotechnology signatures, making their point of origin indeterminable. They may have been deposited on the planet by some unknown spacefarers for an unknown purpose.

As far as [Root.GetLeaderName] can tell, the nanites compiled themselves into perfectly oriented crystalline lattices and replicated until a point at which they became deactivated. While the crystals they created do in fact resemble buildings, they are entirely uniform in composition, and cannot possibly have served any such purpose.

对笼罩[From.GetName]地表的巨大金属晶体的研究结果让所有人大吃一惊，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]十分兴奋的告诉我们说这些巨大的晶体其实是数万亿个已经失去行动机能的纳米机器人！

没有任何证据表明[From.GetName]上面曾经有过可以支持生命活动的大气层，因此可能是某种未知舰船出于不明原因而将这些纳米机器人散布于这个行星之上的。

[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这些纳米机器人将自身改造为完美的晶体格子形状并进行自我复制，直到最后失去机能为止。虽然它们创造的晶体类似于建筑，但其在构成上却是完全一样的，因此无法作为建筑使用。
descriptions.en:
Detailed analysis of the enormous metallic crystals dominating [From.GetName]'s landscape have defied all expectations. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is excited to reveal that these oversized crystals are in fact composed of trillions upon trillions of deactivated nanites!

There is no evidence of [From.GetName] having had an atmosphere thick enough to support life as we know it at any point in the past. The nanites may have been deposited on the planet by some unknown spacefarers for an unknown purpose.

As far as [Root.GetLeaderName] can tell, the nanites compiled themselves into perfectly oriented crystalline lattices and replicated until a point at which they became deactivated. While the crystals they created do in fact resemble buildings, they are entirely uniform in composition, and cannot possibly have served any such purpose.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]汇报称在[From.GetName]地表上有了意想不到的重大发现，除了星球地表上的沙丘中含有罕见金属颗粒之外，沙子本身是由无数破损的纳米机器人所构成！

这些微型机器人已经有数百万年的历史了，它们的结构破碎严重，根本无法再次启动，我们已无法确定这些纳米机器的起源，但可以肯定的是，造出这些纳米机器人的社会拥有高度发达的科技文明。

[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetName]认为这些纳米机器人是数百万年前用来对[From.GetName]的地表进行环境改造的。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has reported an unanticipated find on the surface of [From.GetName]. Not only are the plentiful sand dunes on the planet composed of rare metal granulate: the sand itself is almost entirely composed of countless broken nanites!

These microscopic machines are millions of years old, their structure degraded far beyond any chance for reactivation. While we cannot determine a source of origin for these nanomachines, the society that created them must have been highly technologically advanced.

[Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetName] postulates that the nanites may have been used to terraform the surface [From.GetName], millions of years ago.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]那里传来惊人消息：深度扫描发现[From.GetName]有个非常巨大的坚固核心，核心外面覆盖着众多医学建筑的残骸，其历史长达数百万年之久！

虽然气态巨行星那巨大的气压让我们很难取得其核心表面的数据，但[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]十分确定核心表面的建筑所用的科技与神秘的§HL-星门§!所用的科技是完全一致的。

据推测[From.GetName]是传送门建造者们在数百万年前所造的行星医疗设施，后来这个设施被遗弃了，设施上的自动天然气制造系统无人维护，在数百万年里一直不断的制造气体，就这样慢慢的将原来的行星变成了气态巨行星。
descriptions.en:
Astounding news from the [Root.GetName]: deep scans have revealed the unexpectedly large solid core of [From.GetName] to be covered with the compressed remains of a sprawling medical complex, millions of years old!

Though the intense mantle pressure of the gas giant severely limits the amount of data we can extract from the core's surface, [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the hidden structures match, beyond a doubt, the technology used in the enigmatic §HL-Gates§!.

It's possible that [From.GetName] was a planetary medical facility created by the Gatebuilders millennia ago. At some point the complex was abandoned, and its automated gas replicators ran unchecked for untold centuries, gradually converting the planet into a gas giant.
